Price spread in this category: moderate (Watsons/Guardian converged; Sephora premium above). Tiers follow the eight-tier frame: default/no-purchase, cheap substitute, direct set, category incumbent (the rungs of the customer's mental ladder), adjacent crossover, indirect, and new entrants derived from public opening records.
